all_seats.note: Peltola leads Sullivan on first choices but is under 50 percent, so the seat goes to ranked-choice tabulation on November 18.

Colom leads Hyde-Smith by roughly 43 votes with affidavit ballots outstanding. Mississippi has no automatic recount.
Alme beat the independent Seth Bodnar, not a Democrat.

projection.note: Class I and the settled Class II seats are holdovers: nobody votes on them in 2028. Class III is on the ballot, so its seats enter at their rating, and the 6 toss-ups enter nowhere. Alaska and Mississippi are 2026 races still being counted, so they are open here too.
